longTitle.officialTitle: to restore the broad scope of coverage and to clarify the application of title IX of the Education Amendments of 1972, section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, the Age Discrimination Act of 1975, and title VI of the Civil Rights Act of 1964.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: short title
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Civil Rights Restoration Act of 1987”.

paragraph.content: certain aspects of recent decisions and opinions of the Supreme Court have unduly narrowed or cast doubt upon the broad application of title IX of the Education Amendments of 1972, section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, the Age Discrimination Act of 1975, and title VI of the Civil Rights Act of 1964; and
legislative action is necessary to restore the prior consistent and long-standing executive branch interpretation and broad, institution-wide application of those laws as previously administered.

subsection.editorialNote: [Amends title IX of the Education Amendments of 1972 by adding at the end the new sections 908 and 909.]

section.heading: rehabilitation act amendment
section.editorialNote: [Amends section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973.]

section.heading: age discrimination act amendment
section.editorialNote: [Amends section 309 of the Age Discrimination Act of 1975.]

section.heading: civil rights act amendment
section.editorialNote: [Amends title VI of the Civil Rights Act of 1964.]

section.heading: rule of construction
section.content: Nothing in the amendments made by this Act shall be construed to extend the application of the Acts so amended to ultimate beneficiaries of Federal financial assistance excluded from coverage before the enactment of this Act.

section.heading: abortion neutrality
section.content: No provision of this Act or any amendment made by this Act shall be construed to force or require any individual or hospital or any other institution, program, or activity receiving Federal Funds to perform or pay for an abortion.

section.heading: clarification of individuals with handicaps in the employment context
section.editorialNote: [Amends section 7(8) of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973.]
